tickets.title: Create the Todos Table
tickets.description: Create the `todos` table that links to the `users` table. It must have `id`, `user_id` (foreign key), `title`, `priority` (integer default 3), `due_date` (date), and `status` (defaulting to 'pending').
tasks: Create the `todos` table that links to the `users` table. It must have `id`, `user_id` (foreign key), `title`, `priority` (integer default 3), `due_date` (date), and `status` (defaulting to 'pending').
learning_objectives: Understand FOREIGN KEY constraints and DEFAULT values.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

solution.query.sql:
CREATE TABLE todos (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority INTEGER DEFAULT 3,
    due_date DATE,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending',
    FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
